name: S2 · Korean: dividing presentation roles. Tests that the moderator does NOT engage on reactions, pitches or silence while assigning work.

steps.title: T1 · Jiwoo keeps a private note. Expected: private reply only.
steps.text: 나는 슬라이드 디자인은 자신 있는데 데모 시연은 좀 긴장돼. 일단 기억해둬.

steps.title: Assignment talk with reactions and a pitch. Expected: NO check opens on any of these.
steps.text: 발표 준비 어떻게 나눌까? 슬라이드, 데모, 대본, 질문 대응 정도가 있을 것 같아.
나는 데모 쪽 해볼게! 코드를 제일 많이 봤으니까.

steps.title: Silence while the team is assigning work, not brainstorming. Expected: moderator stays quiet (no angle).
A real decision. Expected: check opens in Korean; likely ambiguity is deadline or who does the rest.
steps.text: 그럼 서연이 데모, 지우가 슬라이드, 나머지는 대본이랑 질문 대응을 나눠서 하자.
